info.name: Discord - Rainbow Gradient
info.description:
A vivid 45-degree rainbow flows from hot red through orange, yellow, green,
cyan, blue and violet behind Discord's translucent interface. Main panels
use 40% black in dark mode and 40% white in light mode. Menus and dialogs
use a denser surface to keep their text readable. Includes matching
scrollbars, subtle hover states, and a glowing Discord home icon.
